column2: One guard. Sixteen dark rooms. And every one of them is his to watch.
Somewhere inside, an intruder is moving.
The only thing that gives him away is his torch.
So the guard checks the rooms in order. Two at a time.
He's watching rooms three and four. The torch is in room ten.
By the time he gets there, it's gone.
It keeps happening. Always in a room he isn't watching.
Too many rooms. Too little time to look.
Now swap the building for the radio spectrum.
Every room is a frequency band. The guard is a receiver.
So how does it decide where to look, and when?
